metadata.name: NyayaSetu Legal RAG Benchmark Dataset
metadata.description: Comprehensive evaluation questions across the 7 indexed statutory enactments in NyayaSetu plus out-of-scope and ambiguous queries.

questions.question: What fundamental rights are guaranteed by the Constitution of India?
questions.notes: Core fundamental rights query across Part III.

questions.question: What rights are guaranteed by the Constitution?
